status: Critical 0 / High 0; six Moderate retained and not dismissed
source: pnpm audit JSON on pinned current dependencies

findings.risk: CPU denial of service during YAML merge parsing
findings.exposure: Swagger dependency; no untrusted YAML upload/parser endpoint in inspected API.
findings.mitigation: Do not introduce untrusted YAML parsing; targeted patch before enabling such input.

findings.exposure: AJV/schema dependencies; provider fetch allowlists independently use exact WHATWG URL origins.
findings.mitigation: Keep URI schema normalization separate from security origin decisions; targeted patch backlog.

findings.risk: Same normalization advisory in a second installed major
findings.exposure: Transitive AJV/Prisma tooling; not used to authorize provider/network origins.
findings.mitigation: Upgrade the affected transitive path separately with schema/Prisma regressions.

findings.exposure: No mailto generation/send flow using fast-uri found in inspected implementation.
findings.mitigation: No user URI-to-email-header conversion; targeted patch backlog.

findings.exposure: Lint/glob tooling and fixed static-serving patterns; no caller-controlled glob route found.
findings.mitigation: Keep filesystem patterns static; targeted patch backlog.

findings.risk: HTTP/2 trailer handling denial of service
findings.exposure: Inspected API uses HTTP/1 FastifyAdapter, not HTTP/2. Production configuration not changed or actively attacked.
findings.mitigation: Do not enable HTTP/2 before remediation; targeted patch and trailer regressions prior to release exposure change.

release_condition: Six Moderate findings remain visible. Security/release owner review is required; this engineering task is not a production release approval.
